We're looking for a Sales Coordinator to join our Manila team, one of the world's leading branded merchandise companies. You'll work directly alongside global Account Managers, helping deliver merchandise programs for some of the biggest brands in the world. This is a coordination and client support role at its core, and a proven launchpad into a career in sales. Room to Grow Your Career The Sales Coordinator role is a strong foundation for building a career with the client. Coordinators who want to move toward Sales typically progress into an Associate Account Manager role, and from there, into other client-facing or leadership positions within Sales Operations. Progression depends on individual readiness, performance, and business needs, but there's a real, well-supported path for coordinators who want to grow.

jobs.title: Category Analyst
jobs.description: The Category Analyst is crucial in supporting the planning and execution of sales targets, analyzing sales data, coordinating demand planning for new collections, managing inventory effectively, and conducting competitor checks. They work closely with departments such as Sales, Creative, Marketing, Visual Merchandising, Production, Quality Control, and Distribution to ensure alignment and optimize performance. What you'll do: Target Setting: Assist in setting monthly sales targets based on historical sales trends per month per class category and store performance. Sales Data Analysis: Monitor sell-through of all collections launched within the past six months. Generate monthly sales reports for assigned categories. Demand Planning and Execution for New Collections: Collaborate in proposing collection budgets based on historical sales trends. Assist in planning upcoming collection demand by analyzing class type, sub-class types, sizes, fabric, color, and design/styles. Support in proposing store budgets aligned with the total demand planned for upcoming collections. Assist in allocating inventory to stores and online platforms based on targets. Coordinate with Production and Quality Control departments to ensure the availability of new collections before the launch date. Coordinate with the Distribution Department to align delivery schedules based on allocation. Generate reports comparing transfer orders versus out slips for new collections. Inventory Management: Analyze monthly inventory and three-month average sales to identify Months to Sell (MTS). Facilitate the repeat of available stocks from the warehouse and pull-out from other stores based on demand. Identify and consolidate low and broken on-hand quantities per style in all stores to the store with the highest sales demand. Support markdown strategies based on a markdown calendar and propose markdowns based on remaining on-hand quantities and sell-through rates. Competitors Check: Conduct regular competitor
